diagnostics.name: case-bound-by-name
diagnostics.message: `loans#renew-limit` is active, and the tag at tests/loans.test.js:2 binds the case `Loans renews` to the test `renews` by a weak link: the case has no `file` and its `classname` names no test file; add `case:"Loans renews"` if the case is the test under the tag, or make the runner write the file and the whole name of each case (jest-junit: `addFileAttribute: "true"`)
diagnostics.fix: A `covers:` tag has a weak bind: a case fits by its name only (it has no `file` and its `classname` names no test file), or no case has the whole name of the test (a case only ends with it), or more than one test of the reports fits. The bind counts, but a case of another file or of another test can take the place of the case of the test. The worst of all cases that fit decides. If the case is the test under the tag, add `case:"<case>"` to the tag. As an alternative, make the runner write the file of each case (jest-junit: `addFileAttribute: "true"`).

diagnostics.name: requirement-unproven
diagnostics.message: `loans#fines` is active, and the tag at tests/test_import.py:1 stands above no test (line 2 is not a test); put the tag on the line above the test, or add `case:"<name>"`
diagnostics.fix: A `covers:` tag names the requirement, and no test case that binds to the tag passed in the report. Make the test run and pass. Put the tag above the test, or add `case:<name>` to the tag. As an alternative, add `<!-- verified-by: <path> -->` for a check by a person.
